conf.description: PostgreSQL Audit (pgaudit) server-log / csv-file: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: postgresql-audit / server-log / csv-file. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (PostgreSQL integration (log data stream, csvlog path)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
